title: fix: restart degraded Klein tunnel
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Restarts cloudflared when Klein stays below two HA connections for 30 seconds
- Preserves the required QUIC Workers VPC transport and existing four-connection promotion gate
- Documents the August 11 tunnel recovery incident and live mitigation

Verification: shell syntax checks pass; the watchdog is active on production instance 47353224.

gist.headline: Tunnel learns to self-heal
gist.blurb: Klein now notices when its cloudflared tunnel is running thin and gives it a polite restart. The bees keep finding their way home.
gist.summary: Added a Klein cloudflared watchdog that restarts the tunnel after it remains below two HA connections for 30 seconds, while retaining the required QUIC Workers VPC transport and four-connection promotion gate.
gist.impact: Image GPU traffic gets more reliable tunnel recovery when Klein loses HA connections, reducing the need for someone to manually investigate a grumpy cloudflared process.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Klein's network tunnel as a cozy garden burrow with four glowing connection paths, two of which are being carefully restored by Polli. Polli wears a tiny mechanic tool belt and checks a small retro terminal watchdog while code-vines and flowers grow around the tunnel, representing automatic recovery without changing its existing transport rules.

Prominent lime green (#ecf874) tunnel glow with warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach gradients, code-plants and vines around the burrow, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
